why: The section titles are bold, larger paragraphs, so they are absent from the heading list a screen reader navigates by. axe compares each paragraph's weight and size against its siblings, and also requires the styled paragraph to be shorter than the paragraph that follows it - which is why the example headings here are a single word, and worth knowing before you conclude the rule is broken. The fix changes only the element: the inline style that produced the appearance is kept, so the page looks identical and gains an outline.
